intro: Our Elbe Recliner is built to move with you—soft, quiet, and effortlessly smooth. With remote-powered reclining and a plush, breathable fabric, it’s our version of a first-class seat for your everyday.

features.title: Luxury that listens to you
features.text: With remote-controlled recline and a max angle of 155°, Elbe brings the ease of a business-class seat into your living room—so you can fine-tune your comfort with zero effort.

features.title: We keep things cool and soft
features.text: Upholstered in breathable fabric, Elbe offers that perfect balance of touchable softness and all-day cool.

features.title: Support that embraces completely
features.text: From your head to your lower back, we’ve packed the Elbe with thoughtful cushioning that aligns and soothes every part of you.

features.title: Elevated in every sense
features.text: Our PVC legs aren’t just stylish—they raise the recliner to the perfect height for easy access and better airflow, while staying sturdy and durable underneath it all.

features.title: A curve that welcomes you in
features.text: The gently rounded armrests are designed to contour with your natural posture—offering a soft, supportive landing whether you're sitting up or reclining fully.

features.title: Keep your calm—and your magazines
features.text: We added a sleek side pocket to keep your magazines, remotes, or reading glasses right where you need them—so everything you love is always within reach.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Elbe Motorised 1-Seater Fabric Recliner Sofa
